cookieyes-consent.description: CookieYes sets this cookie to remember users' consent preferences so that their preferences are respected on their subsequent visits to this site. It does not collect or store any personal information of the site visitors.

secure_customer_sig.description: Shopify sets this cookie to be used in connection with customer login.

cart_currency.description: Shopify sets this cookie to remember the user’s country of origin and populate the correct transaction currency.

_orig_referrer.description: Shopify sets this cookie to be used in connection with shopping cart.

shopify_pay_redirect.description: Shopify sets this cookie to enable secure online payment and checkout.

_pay_session.description: Shopify sets this cookie to enable secure checkout and payment function on the website.

cf_use_ob.description: Cloudflare sets this cookie to improve page load times and to disallow any security restrictions based on the visitor's IP address.

__cf_bm.description: Cloudflare set the cookie to support Cloudflare Bot Management.

cf_ob_info.description: The cf_ob_info cookie is set by Cloudflare to provide information on HTTP Status Code returned by the origin web server, the Ray ID of the original failed request and the data center serving the traffic.

cart.description: Shopify sets this cookie to provide a connection with the shopping cart.

cart_ts.description: Shopify sets this cookie which is used in connection with checkout.

_GRECAPTCHA.description: Google Recaptcha service sets this cookie to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

rc::a.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

rc::f.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

rc::c.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

rc::b.description: This cookie is set by the Google recaptcha service to identify bots to protect the website against malicious spam attacks.

wpm-test-cookie.description: The wpm-test-cookie is used to check if the user's browser supports cookies, essential for providing a functional website experience.

bcookie.description: LinkedIn sets this cookie from LinkedIn share buttons and ad tags to recognize browser ID.

lidc.description: LinkedIn sets the lidc cookie to facilitate data center selection.

localization.description: Flickr sets this cookie to to track usage of photo galleries embedded from Flickr.

sp_t.description: The sp_t cookie is set by Spotify to implement audio content from Spotify on the website and also registers information on user interaction related to the audio content.

sp_landing.description: The sp_landing is set by Spotify to implement audio content from Spotify on the website and also registers information on user interaction related to the audio content.

ytidb::LAST_RESULT_ENTRY_KEY.description: The cookie ytidb::LAST_RESULT_ENTRY_KEY is used by YouTube to store the last search result entry that was clicked by the user. This information is used to improve the user experience by providing more relevant search results in the future.

yt-player-headers-readable.description: The yt-player-headers-readable cookie is used by YouTube to store user preferences related to video playback and interface, enhancing the user's viewing experience.

yt-remote-session-app.description: The yt-remote-session-app cookie is used by YouTube to store user preferences and information about the interface of the embedded YouTube video player.

yt-remote-cast-installed.description: The yt-remote-cast-installed cookie is used to store the user's video player preferences using embedded YouTube video.

yt-remote-cast-available.description: The yt-remote-cast-available cookie is used to store the user's preferences regarding whether casting is available on their YouTube video player.

yt-remote-session-name.description: The yt-remote-session-name cookie is used by YouTube to store the user's video player preferences using embedded YouTube video.

yt-remote-fast-check-period.description: The yt-remote-fast-check-period cookie is used by YouTube to store the user's video player preferences for embedded YouTube videos.

yt-player-bandwidth.description: The yt-player-bandwidth cookie is used to store the user's video player preferences and settings, particularly related to bandwidth and streaming quality on YouTube.

_ga.description: The _ga cookie, installed by Google Analytics, calculates visitor, session and campaign data and also keeps track of site usage for the site's analytics report. The cookie stores information anonymously and assigns a randomly generated number to recognize unique visitors.

browser_id.description: This cookie is used for identifying the visitor browser on re-visit to the website.

_ga_*.description: Google Analytics sets this cookie to store and count page views.

_shopify_y.description: This cookie is associated with Shopify's analytics suite.

_shopify_s.description: This cookie is associated with Shopify's analytics suite.

_landing_page.description: Shopify installs this cookie to track landing pages.

_shopify_sa_t.description: Shopify sets this cookie for marketing & referrals.

_shopify_sa_p.description: Shopify sets this cookie for marketing & referrals.

CLID.description: Microsoft Clarity set this cookie to store information about how visitors interact with the website. The cookie helps to provide an analysis report. The data collection includes the number of visitors, where they visit the website, and the pages visited.

_clck.description: Microsoft Clarity sets this cookie to retain the browser's Clarity User ID and settings exclusive to that website. This guarantees that actions taken during subsequent visits to the same website will be linked to the same user ID.

SM.description: Microsoft Clarity cookie set this cookie for synchronizing the MUID across Microsoft domains.

MR.description: This cookie, set by Bing, is used to collect user information for analytics purposes.

_clsk.description: Microsoft Clarity sets this cookie to store and consolidate a user's pageviews into a single session recording.

cart_sig.description: Shopify sets this cookie to be used in connection with store checkout.

SRM_B.description: Used by Microsoft Advertising as a unique ID for visitors.

personalization_id.description: Twitter sets this cookie to integrate and share features for social media and also store information about how the user uses the website, for tracking and targeting.

_fbp.description: This cookie is set by Facebook to display advertisements when either on Facebook or on a digital platform powered by Facebook advertising, after visiting the website.

fr.description: Facebook sets this cookie to show relevant advertisements to users by tracking user behaviour across the web, on sites that have Facebook pixel or Facebook social plugin.

YSC.description: YSC cookie is set by Youtube and is used to track the views of embedded videos on Youtube pages.

VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE.description: A cookie set by YouTube to measure bandwidth that determines whether the user gets the new or old player interface.

yt-remote-device-id.description: YouTube sets this cookie to store the video preferences of the user using embedded YouTube video.

yt.innertube::requests.description: This cookie, set by YouTube, registers a unique ID to store data on what videos from YouTube the user has seen.

yt.innertube::nextId.description: This cookie, set by YouTube, registers a unique ID to store data on what videos from YouTube the user has seen.

yt-remote-connected-devices.description: YouTube sets this cookie to store the video preferences of the user using embedded YouTube video.

guest_id_marketing.description: Twitter sets this cookie to identify and track the website visitor.

guest_id_ads.description: Twitter sets this cookie to identify and track the website visitor.

guest_id.description: Twitter sets this cookie to identify and track the website visitor. It registers if a user is signed in to the Twitter platform and collects information about ad preferences.

scribd_ubtc.description: Scribd sets this cookie to gather data on user behaviour across several websites and maximise the relevancy of the advertisements on the website.

test_cookie.description: doubleclick.net sets this cookie to determine if the user's browser supports cookies.

locale_bar_accepted.description: Facebook sets this cookie to the display locale of the last logged-in user on the browser and it has a one-week lifetime.

MUID.description: Bing sets this cookie to recognise unique web browsers visiting Microsoft sites. This cookie is used for advertising, site analytics, and other operations.

ANONCHK.description: The ANONCHK cookie, set by Bing, is used to store a user's session ID and verify ads' clicks on the Bing search engine. The cookie helps in reporting and personalization as well.

cky_preference_necessary_description: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.
cky_preference_functional_description: Functional cookies help perform certain functionalities like sharing the content of the website on social media platforms, collecting feedback, and other third-party features.
cky_preference_analytics_description: Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.
cky_preference_performance_description: Performance cookies are used to understand and analyze the key performance indexes of the website which helps in delivering a better user experience for the visitors.
cky_preference_advertisement_description: Advertisement cookies are used to provide visitors with customized advertisements based on the pages you visited previously and to analyze the effectiveness of the ad campaigns.
cky_preference_other_description: Other uncategorized cookies are those that are being analyzed and have not been classified into a category as yet.
